text:
The Nifty 50 edged up 0.06% to 25,044.65, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.47% to 23,567.0, indicating a modest but market‑wide gain. Advances outpaced declines (315 vs 175) and the breadth score stayed healthy at 71.8, with three‑quarters of stocks above their 20‑day moving average. The India VIX fell to 17.42, signalling lower volatility.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹7,212 crore today and a 5‑day total of ₹50,058 crore, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹7,173 crore. The banking theme stayed strong – Bank Nifty up 1.11% to 59,741.25 – and the sector quadrant shows banks and financial services leading. Options data point to a “max‑pain” level around 25,000 for Nifty, with a put‑call‑ratio of 1.07, suggesting slight bearish tilt in open interest.

Watch the 25,000‑25,150 zone for Nifty and the 59,165‑60,029 band for Bank Nifty. Key levels are the pivot points (P = 24,989.15 for Nifty, 59,453.45 for Bank Nifty) and the 200‑day moving averages (23,996 and 56,639 respectively). Any break of these supports/resistances, plus fresh FII flow data, will shape the next session.
